page.layout: Three columns of index entries under a running head "INDEX." at top centre. The first column runs from "Gentes omnes" to "gloriæ inuidi"; the second from "gloriæ coniunctum" to "gloriæ diuinæ"; the third from "omnibus præferenda" to "hæsitas". No printed page number. A catchword and a gathering mark sit at the foot of the third column. Small numbers along the left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.

page.notes: The first column's "[?]cluris" in "gladius ex ore Christi porrectus in piis cluris quid notet" is uncertain. The mark "A" at the foot may be a signature or part of the catchword "Ahæsitas"; I have read it as a signature. Several numbers in the third column are faint and may be misread. The line "gratiarum actio 2044. 678 a" has an uncertain "2044". The Greek entry "γυναικών" is read from a faint print and may be inaccurate. The large H initial is joined to "Abere" as printed. The left-edge numerals and marks belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
